report_name: COLDCARD Wallet RNG Flaw Linked to $88.6 Million Bitcoin Theft

vulnerabilities.name: COLDCARD Wallet RNG Flaw
vulnerabilities.description: A firmware vulnerability in COLDCARD hardware wallets, manufactured by Coinkite, caused the device to use a weak, deterministic software-based pseudorandom number generator (Yasmarang) instead of a secure hardware RNG. This allowed attackers to predict and reconstruct private keys by scanning the Bitcoin blockchain for addresses matching the predictable seeds.

identities.name: COLDCARD Wallet Users
identities.description: A class of victims who created wallets on COLDCARD devices with flawed firmware. An estimated 4,585 wallet addresses were compromised, resulting in the theft of approximately $88.6 million in Bitcoin.
